basis: Release-only portability changes; no scientific calculations or data values changed.

changes.change: Writes its figure-input receipt to results/figure_inputs_v021.json rather than a submission directory.
Writes regenerated uncertainty output to results/ by default, stores portable source basenames, and records an archive only when its contents were actually read.
Added a saved-evidence CSV exporter for headline scores, the eight-map comparison, and representative wall widths.
Added a standalone entry point for regenerating figures from saved records.
Replaced only the machine-local source path with the portable sibling filename; original record hash is retained in portable_path_redactions.json and SOURCE_ARCHIVE_SHA256SUMS.
Changed the default scan-archive directory from an AJ-specific temporary path to a portable package-relative data/processed_mos2 location.

Figure sources and PDFs for all 14 parallel-stacked maps. The current and earlier plot scripts have separate output directories. Shared plotting support uses the same portable replay defaults as the preceding release.
Runs the five plotting commands for the 11 figures used in the article and its supplement.
